narrative.overview: The implemented dashboard frame uses a slim left sidebar, a compact utility topbar, metric cards, and clear white bordered panels. The shared frame supports scanning operational information while retaining each role's existing content and actions.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral panels with restrained role accents.
Metric values and tables use tabular numerals.
A collapsible desktop rail becomes a mobile drawer.
dos: Do reuse the shared frame and its role palette for authenticated workspaces.
Do preserve data, actions, workflows, and server role permissions.
Do keep financial values readable and table overflow contained.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't apply this dashboard system to welcome, storefront, or authentication surfaces.
Don't replace module status meanings with the decorative role accent.
Don't add dependencies, schema changes, or business workflow changes as styling side effects.
